name: CoorBoltEle
comment: Returns the elevation of a bolt and its nuts as an n×2 array. Argument order is Dia, Length, NutNum_Top, NutNum_Bot, NutWidth, NutThick, then optional x and y. The shank is a rectangle of height Length and width Dia, centered on the origin. NutNum_Top and NutNum_Bot draw 1 or 2 nuts; any other count draws no nut. Each nut sits against a shank end. Rows of #N/A separate the shank from the nuts. Optional x and y translate every point; supply both or neither. Supplying only one of x or y returns #VALUE!. Non-numeric sizes return #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
